# sumExtras

> **sumExtras**: “**SUM**mary table **EXTRAS**”

## Overview

[sumExtras](https://github.com/kyleGrealis/sumExtras) reduces the
repetitive boilerplate in
[gtsummary](https://github.com/ddsjoberg/gtsummary) workflows. One
function replaces five. Stop copy-pasting
[`add_overall()`](https://www.danieldsjoberg.com/gtsummary/reference/add_overall.html),
[`add_p()`](https://www.danieldsjoberg.com/gtsummary/reference/add_p.html),
[`bold_labels()`](https://www.danieldsjoberg.com/gtsummary/reference/bold_italicize_labels_levels.html),
and
[`modify_header()`](https://www.danieldsjoberg.com/gtsummary/reference/modify.html)
on every table. Call
[`extras()`](https://www.kyleGrealis.com/sumExtras/reference/extras.md)
once. The package also handles missing value cleanup, automatic variable
labeling from data dictionaries, group header styling, and JAMA compact
theming.

## Installation

### CRAN

``` r
install.packages("sumExtras")
```

### Development version

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("kyleGrealis/sumExtras")
```

## Quick Start

``` r
library(sumExtras)
library(gtsummary)
```

[TABLE]

![Table produced by extras()](reference/figures/readme-example.png)

That single
[`extras()`](https://www.kyleGrealis.com/sumExtras/reference/extras.md)
call replaces
[`add_overall()`](https://www.danieldsjoberg.com/gtsummary/reference/add_overall.html),
[`add_p()`](https://www.danieldsjoberg.com/gtsummary/reference/add_p.html),
[`bold_labels()`](https://www.danieldsjoberg.com/gtsummary/reference/bold_italicize_labels_levels.html),
[`bold_p()`](https://www.danieldsjoberg.com/gtsummary/reference/bold_p.html),
and
[`modify_header()`](https://www.danieldsjoberg.com/gtsummary/reference/modify.html).
It also standardizes missing values via
[`clean_table()`](https://www.kyleGrealis.com/sumExtras/reference/clean_table.md).

## Functions

- [`extras()`](https://www.kyleGrealis.com/sumExtras/reference/extras.md)
  – overall column, p-values (bolded), bold labels, clean styling
- [`clean_table()`](https://www.kyleGrealis.com/sumExtras/reference/clean_table.md)
  – standardize missing value display
- [`add_auto_labels()`](https://www.kyleGrealis.com/sumExtras/reference/add_auto_labels.md)
  – automatic labeling from dictionaries or data attributes
- [`use_jama_theme()`](https://www.kyleGrealis.com/sumExtras/reference/use_jama_theme.md)
  /
  [`theme_gt_compact()`](https://www.kyleGrealis.com/sumExtras/reference/theme_gt_compact.md)
  – JAMA compact themes
- [`add_group_styling()`](https://www.kyleGrealis.com/sumExtras/reference/add_group_styling.md)
  – bold/italic formatting for group headers
- [`add_group_colors()`](https://www.kyleGrealis.com/sumExtras/reference/add_group_colors.md)
  – background colors for group headers (converts to
  [gt](https://gt.rstudio.com))
- [`get_group_rows()`](https://www.kyleGrealis.com/sumExtras/reference/get_group_rows.md)
  – extract group header row indices

## Options

- `options(sumExtras.auto_labels = TRUE)` – add labels through the
  project without needing
  [`add_auto_labels()`](https://www.kyleGrealis.com/sumExtras/reference/add_auto_labels.md)
  for each table
- `options(sumExtras.prefer_dictionary = TRUE)` – change the labeling
  priority

## FAQ

**Why not just use [gtsummary](https://github.com/ddsjoberg/gtsummary)
directly?** You can.
[sumExtras](https://github.com/kyleGrealis/sumExtras) wraps the
formatting steps you repeat on every table. If you only make one or two
tables, you don’t need this package.

**What happens if something fails inside
[`extras()`](https://www.kyleGrealis.com/sumExtras/reference/extras.md)?**
It warns and continues. Your table always renders. See the
warn-and-continue design in
[`vignette("sumExtras-intro")`](https://www.kyleGrealis.com/sumExtras/articles/sumExtras-intro.md).

**Why didn’t my dictionary labels show up?** Your data likely has label
attributes that take priority. Set
`options(sumExtras.prefer_dictionary = TRUE)` or see
[`vignette("labeling")`](https://www.kyleGrealis.com/sumExtras/articles/labeling.md).

**Does
[`extras()`](https://www.kyleGrealis.com/sumExtras/reference/extras.md)
work with survey data?** Yes. `tbl_svysummary` tables get the same
treatment as `tbl_summary`.

# Package index

## Core Table Styling

Main functions for adding professional formatting to gtsummary tables

- [`extras()`](https://www.kyleGrealis.com/sumExtras/reference/extras.md)
  : Add standard styling and formatting to gtsummary tables
- [`clean_table()`](https://www.kyleGrealis.com/sumExtras/reference/clean_table.md)
  : Standardize missing value display across all gtsummary table types

## Automatic Variable Labeling

Functions for managing variable labels from data dictionaries

- [`add_auto_labels()`](https://www.kyleGrealis.com/sumExtras/reference/add_auto_labels.md)
  : Add automatic labels from dictionary to a gtsummary table

## Theme Functions

Apply JAMA-style compact themes for consistent professional formatting

- [`use_jama_theme()`](https://www.kyleGrealis.com/sumExtras/reference/use_jama_theme.md)
  : Apply JAMA Compact Theme to gtsummary Tables
- [`theme_gt_compact()`](https://www.kyleGrealis.com/sumExtras/reference/theme_gt_compact.md)
  : Apply compact JAMA-style theme to gt tables

## Group Header Styling

Enhanced formatting for variable group headers in summary tables

- [`add_group_styling()`](https://www.kyleGrealis.com/sumExtras/reference/add_group_styling.md)
  : Apply styling to variable group headers in gtsummary tables
- [`add_group_colors()`](https://www.kyleGrealis.com/sumExtras/reference/add_group_colors.md)
  : Add background colors to group headers with automatic gt conversion
- [`get_group_rows()`](https://www.kyleGrealis.com/sumExtras/reference/get_group_rows.md)
  : Get row numbers of variable group headers for gt styling
